function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: 2015 年的國際象棋錦標賽（即第 42 屆世界團體奧林匹克）在阿塞拜疆巴庫舉行，最終獲得金牌的是俄羅斯隊。銀牌和銅牌分別由中國隊和烏克蘭隊拿下。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？" They want the winner of the 2015 Chess Olympiad? Or maybe the World Chess Championship? The phrase "國際象棋錦標賽" could refer to the Chess Olympiad or the World Chess Championship. But likely they mean the Chess Olympiad. The 2015 Chess Olympiad was held in Baku, Azerbaijan. The winners were Russia (gold), China (silver), and Ukraine (bronze). So answer: Russia won gold. If they ask "who won?" we can say Russia. Alternatively, if they refer to the World Chess Championship 2015, it was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin, with Carlsen winning. But the phrase "國際象棋錦標賽" is ambiguous. However, the most common is the Chess Olympiad. So answer: Russia. Provide details.
